title: Go Tlhokomela ga Batho ba ba Hlofetsweng
intro: O tloga o kopana le mowa o o lekilweng ke kgaogano e e tseneletseng, o matlho a one a neng a itse puo ya dikeledi le fa go ntse jalo pelo ya one e sa latlhegelwe ke tsholofelo. Mo kgannyeng ya tsietso, go tlhologelelwa, le go kopana gape kwa bofelong, motlhanka yono yo o tlotlegang wa ga Allah o ne a nna letshwao la bopelotelele ka metlha. Ke mang yo o neng a itshokela dingwaga tsa botlhoko jo bo fitlhegileng, mme a bo a bona le go itumela gape mo motsotsong o le mongwe fela?
clues: Ke moporofeti yo leina la gagwe le neng la nna letshwao la bopelotelele mo sefatlhegong sa tatlhegelo e kgolo.
Ke ne ke segofaditswe ka barwa ba le bantsi, mme mongwe o ne a tsewa mo go nna ke lefufa la batho ba bangwe.

Lorato lwa me mo go yo o latlhegileng yoo lo ne lo le boteng thata mo matlho a me a neng a fetoga masweu ka ntlha ya kutlobotlhoko, le fa go ntse jalo ga ke ise ke ko ke ngongorege fa e se kwa go Allah fela.
Ke ne ka romela bomorwaake gape go ya go batla yo ke neng ke latlhegetswe le morwarraagwe, ke ba rotloetsa gore ba se ka ba latlhegelwa ke tsholofelo.
Fa motshodi wa dikgang tse di molemo a goroga, ke ne ka latlhelwa hempe mo sefatlhegong sa me, mme ka tshoganyetso fela lefatshe le ne la tlhapa gape.
Ke itsege jaaka Iseraele, mme mo go bomorwaake ba ba lesome le bobedi go ne ga tswa merafe e le lesome le bobedi ya setšhaba se segolo.

arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ فَٱرْتَدَّ بَصِيرًۭا ۖ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And when the bearer of good tidings arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allāh that which you do not know?" (12:96)
